title: Villa Grandeur
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Villa Grandeur”, a Gulf Front luxury 10-bed, 10.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 26 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Game Room, Elevator & Golf Cart. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights: - Gulf Front Home w/ Private Beach - Private heated resort style pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $100 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 - Elevator - Chefs Kitchen - 6 Adult Bikes Included - 6 seater Golf Cart included Introducing Villa Grandeur, a masterpiece of Gulf front living nestled in the heart of Seagrove Beach along picturesque County Highway 30A. This brand-new construction, meticulously designed by Archiscapes & Cronk Duch, stands as the epitome of opulence and sophistication. Boasting 10 full-bedroom suites and over 8,200 square feet of luxurious living space, Villa Grandeur offers a lifestyle of unrivaled elegance. Property Features: Prime Location: Villa Grandeur enjoys a prime Gulf front location with unobstructed views of the sparkling waters. Resort-Style Amenities: Immerse yourself in resort-style living with a private heated pool and spa jacuzzi featuring a fire feature and waterfall. The outdoor space includes an inviting lounge on the beach-level infinity deck, perfect for soaking in the breathtaking surroundings. Elevator: Convenience meets luxury with a private elevator that effortlessly connects all three levels of this architectural marvel. Chef’s Kitchen: The culinary enthusiast will appreciate the chef’s kitchen equipped with a massive island, remarkable chrome vent hood, integrated appliances, and a grand gas range. Entertainment Spaces: Villa Grandeur offers various entertainment spaces, including a game room with a billiards table, a spacious family room, and a stunning wet bar. The open-concept living space features a gigantic fireplace and double accordion sliders framing panoramic Gulf views, leading to a second-floor infinity deck. Outdoor Enjoyment: Take advantage of the complimentary beach setups, complete with 2 chairs and 1 umbrella, provided from March 1 to October 31. Explore the area with the six adult bikes and a six-seater golf cart included with your stay. Villa Grandeur offers an exquisite array of sleeping arrangements across its three levels and Carriage House. On the first floor, you’ll find a charming Bunk Room featuring One Queen over Queen and Two Twin over Twin beds, alongside three King Bedrooms, each equipped with a private ensuite bathroom. The second floor continues the luxurious accommodations with two additional King Bedrooms, each boasting its private ensuite. Ascending to the third floor promises an indulgent experience with the Master King Bedroom, complete with a private ensuite and sweeping Gulf views that redefine luxury living. Additionally, two more King Bedrooms on this level offer the utmost comfort, each accompanied by its private ensuite for added convenience. The Carriage House stands as the epitome of ultimate private luxury, featuring a King Bedroom with an ensuite bathroom, ensuring that every guest enjoys a pampered and restful retreat within the grandeur of this Gulf front property.
